pages.title: Upgrade
pages.text:
Place a lower-tier egg in the center of a crafting table surrounded by materials. The upgraded egg summons a new doll inheriting the name and settings.

See "Doll Tiers" for material requirements.

pages.title: Recycle & Death
pages.text:
Right-click a doll with its egg to retrieve it. The egg carries the doll's inventory data.

On death: drops all items. All eggs become invalid. Cannot be recovered.
